spanish: O carne, cuando fuere en su piel quemadura de fuego, y fuere regeneración de la quemadura mancha blanca rojiza o blanca,

findings.issue: H4241 is a feminine singular construct noun whose lemma stays open among living/raw flesh, sustenance, and reviving. «regeneración» narrows it to a regrowth process and drops the flesh/life noun.

notes: The other tokens match in number, person, and participants, including the asyndetic white reddish or white spot.
